dun.englishDescription: The color of dark brown with a hint of black.

economics.englishDescription: The field of study in which economic phenomena are analyzed and studied.

embankment.definitionKo: 하천이나 호수의 물이 흘러넘치는 것을 막기 위해서 돌이나 흙 등으로 높이 막아 쌓은 긴 언덕.

embankment.definitionKo: 높은 길을 내려고 쌓은 긴 언덕.

embankment.definitionKo: 물이 밀려드는 것을 막기 위해 쌓은 둑.

embankment.definitionKo: 강이나 바다, 호수 등의 물이 넘쳐흐르는 것을 막기 위해 흙이나 돌, 콘크리트 등을 쌓아 만든 시설.
embankment.englishDescription: A facility made of a pile of stones or soil, which is built to keep the water of rivers, seas, lakes, etc., from overflowing.

embankment.definitionKo: 흙이나 돌 등을 높고 평평하게 쌓아 올린 것.
embankment.englishDescription: Soil, stones, rocks, etc., evenly stacked in height.

empirical.definitionKo: 실제로 해 보거나 겪어 본 것에 바탕을 둔.
empirical.englishDescription: Based on actual experience or practice.

empirical.definitionKo: 머리로 깊이 생각하고 따져서 증명하는 것이 아니고, 경험, 관찰, 실험 등에 따라 적극적으로 증명하는.

employ.englishDescription: To pay someone to do work.

encroach.englishDescription: To acquire or occupy something little by little.

endlessness.englishDescription: The state of having no end or never running out.

equation.definitionKo: 서로 다른 둘 이상의 대상을 똑같은 것으로 봄.
equation.englishDescription: The quality of regarding more than two subjects as the same thing.

equation.definitionKo: 수학에서, 등호를 써서 왼쪽과 오른쪽의 값이 서로 같음을 나타내는 식.
equation.englishDescription: In math, an expression indicating that what is on the left of an equal sign is the same as what is on its right.

equation.definitionKo: 미지수에 특정한 값을 주었을 때만 성립하는 등식.
equation.englishDescription: A formula that is valid only when a certain figure is given to the unknown variable.

equation.definitionKo: 수나 양을 나타내는 숫자나 문자로 수학적인 뜻을 나타내도록 한 식.
equation.englishDescription: A mathematical equation with numbers or letters that express a certain number or amount.

erm.definitionKo: 하려던 말이 잘 나오지 않을 때 하는 말.

An exclamation uttered when the speaker gives a light refusal.

erm.definitionKo: 말을 시작하기 전이나 말하기를 망설일 때, 또는 말하는 도중에 뒷말이 바로 나오지 않을 때 내는 군소리.

erm.englishDescription: An exclamation used when one is hesitant since he/she finds it hard to bring up something.

erm.definitionKo: 생각이 잘 나지 않을 때에 쓰는 말.
erm.englishDescription: An exclamation used when one cannot think of something.

eullang-eun.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 특별히 강조하여 지정하는 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
eullang-eun.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to specify and point to a certain subject.

exacerbation.englishDescription: A state in which the symptoms of a disease grow worse.

excursionist.definitionKo: 축제나 유원지 등에 놀러 다니는 사람.

exemplification.englishDescription: The act of proving something by example.

To find out something hidden, and make it public.

fact.definitionKo: 거짓이 없는 사실. 또는 사실과 조금도 틀림이 없는 말.

federation.definitionKo: 같은 목적을 가진 둘 이상의 단체나 국가가 서로 돕기로 약속함. 또는 그런 조직이나 집단.
federation.englishDescription: More than two groups or countries with the same goal promising to help each other; such groups or organizations.

federation.definitionKo: 자치권을 가진 두 개 이상의 주나 나라가 하나의 중앙 정부를 중심으로 연합하여 이루는 국가.
federation.englishDescription: A country established as a result of two or more autonomous states or countries combining to form a central government.

federation.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 국가나 주가 독립된 법과 제도를 가지면서 하나의 주권 아래 연합한 국가 형태.
federation.englishDescription: A form of a state in which two or more countries or states unite under one sovereignty while possessing separate laws and institutions.

finally.englishDescription: In the state of something that one has eagerly waited for being achieved eventually; in the end.

find.englishDescription: To find out a reason, result, or conclusion.

find.englishDescription: To find out for the first time a thing that has not been discovered yet or was unknown to the world.

find.englishDescription: To look here and there in order to gain something or find someone, or to gain something or find someone.

find.englishDescription: To receive something that was lost, stolen, stored, or lent.

find.englishDescription: To search thoroughly for a hidden person, object, etc., and find it.

find.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 어쩌다가 우연히 기회나 일이 생기거나 물건을 얻다.
find.englishDescription: (slang) For things to happen, or to get an opportunity or item by chance.

find.definitionKo: 남의 약점이나 흠 등을 찾거나 알아내어서 이용하다.

forewarned.definitionKo: 미리 준비를 해 놓으면 걱정할 것이 없음.

fortunes.definitionKo: 좋은 일과 나쁜 일, 불행한 일과 행복한 일.

gamju.englishDescription: A sweet-flavored traditional Korean beverage, made by fermenting cooked rice in barley malt water, adding sugar, and boiling it down.

gang.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 같은 목적을 가지고 함께 행동하는 집단.

gangster.englishDescription: (slang) A  person or group acting violently and doing bad things.

gap.definitionKo: 물건이 담긴 작은 상자를 세는 단위.

garae.definitionKo: 둥글고 긴 떡이나 엿 등의 토막의 수를 세는 단위.
garae.englishDescription: A unit for counting the number of pieces of rice cake or yeot in the form of a round, long, and thin stick.

gay.definitionKo: 남자끼리 또는 여자끼리 같은 성 사이의 사랑을 하는 사람.

gero.definitionKo: 어떤 행동의 영향을 받는 대상을 나타내는 조사.

giwatjang.definitionKo: 지붕에 덮기 위해 흙이나 시멘트, 금속 등의 재료를 사용하여 만든 넓적한 물건의 낱장.

too.definitionKo: 일정한 정도나 한계를 훨씬 넘어선 상태로.

tragic.englishDescription: A story or life being sad, unfortunate, and pitiful.

tweezers.definitionKo: 잔털이나 작은 가시 등을 뽑는 데 쓰는, 쇠로 만든 작은 집게.
tweezers.englishDescription: A small pincer-like instrument made of metal that is used for plucking out fine hair, tiny thorns, etc.

uncertain.definitionKo: 그런지 그렇지 않은지 분명하지 않은 모양.
uncertain.englishDescription: In the state of being unsure as to whether it is so or not.

uncertain.definitionKo: 분위기나 정세가 안정되지 않아 어수선한 느낌이 있다.
uncertain.englishDescription: The atmosphere or state being uncertain because it is not stable.
To feel dizzy because the atmosphere or situation is not stable.

uncertain.definitionKo: 사람의 말이나 태도, 벌어진 상황 등이 분명하지 않다.
uncertain.englishDescription: A person's words or attitude, situation, etc., being unclear.

uncertain.definitionKo: 앞으로의 움직임이나 미래의 전망 등이 미리 짐작할 수 없게 분명하지 않다.
uncertain.englishDescription: Upcoming developments, future outlook, etc., being opaque, making it hard to guess in advance.

unconscious.definitionKo: 자기의 행동이나 상태를 자기 스스로 깨닫지 못하는 가운데 일어나는.
unconscious.englishDescription: Happening while a person is not unaware of his/her actions or state.

unification.definitionKo: 여럿인 것이 하나로 됨. 또는 하나로 만듦.
unification.englishDescription: A state in which many different things become one, or the act of unifying many different things into one.

unification.definitionKo: 나누어지거나 갈라진 것들을 합쳐서 하나가 되게 함.
unification.englishDescription: An act of combining what has been divided or split into one.
The act of uniting things into one.

unification.definitionKo: 여러 개의 조직이나 기구 등을 없애거나 합쳐서 하나로 만듦.
unification.englishDescription: An act of making multiple organizations, groups, etc., into one, by closing down or combining all or part of them.

uniformly.definitionKo: 크기나 모양이 큰 차이가 없이 고르고 나란히.
uniformly.englishDescription: In a uniform manner without great difference, in size or shape.

uniformly.definitionKo: 여럿이 모두 똑같아서 마치 하나와 같이.
uniformly.englishDescription: In a manner in which many people behave the same way, as if they were one.

uniformly.definitionKo: 모두가 조금도 다른 데가 없이 꼭 같이.
uniformly.englishDescription: In such a manner that two or more persons or things are not a bit different from each other in appearance, reaction, etc.

uniformly.definitionKo: 여럿의 크기, 모양, 시간, 범위 등이 하나로 정해져서 똑같이.
uniformly.englishDescription: In the state of several things being the same in size, shape, temporal period, range, etc.

unkind.definitionKo: 사람을 대하는 태도가 상냥하거나 부드럽지 않다.
unkind.englishDescription: An attitude toward someone being not gentle and nice.

unload.definitionKo: 등에 지거나 차에 실었던 것을 내려놓다.
unload.englishDescription: To discharge a load from one's back or a vehicle.
To unload freight from a ship.

usefulness.definitionKo: 쓰일 자리. 또는 써야 할 곳.
usefulness.englishDescription: A place or purpose something is used in or for.
The area or field something is used for.

usefulness.definitionKo: 보람 있게 쓰거나 쓰임. 또는 그런 보람이나 쓸모.
usefulness.englishDescription: The use or use of something useful; or such usefulness or use.

uselessly.definitionKo: 말이나 행동에 진실성이나 뚜렷한 목적이 없이.
uselessly.englishDescription: Without truth or definite purpose in one's words or behavior.
In the state of being not worth using.

virtuoso.definitionKo: 특정 분야에서 능력이나 실력이 뛰어난 사람.
virtuoso.englishDescription: A person with outstanding aptitude for or skill in a certain field.

vocabulary.definitionKo: 다양한 낱말을 적절하게 잘 쓸 수 있는 능력.
vocabulary.englishDescription: The ability to show one's knowledge of language by using a variety of words in an appropriate manner.

vocabulary.definitionKo: 일정한 범위에서 쓰이는 낱말의 수. 또는 그런 낱말 전체.
vocabulary.englishDescription: The number of words used within a particular scope; or the aggregate of such words.
A book that contains a collection of words.

warehousing.definitionKo: 창고에 물건을 넣음. 또는 새로운 상품이 들어옴.
warehousing.englishDescription: The act of putting goods into a warehouse; the state of new goods having arrived in a store.

wedge.definitionKo: 물건의 틈에 박아서 그 틈을 메우거나 벌리는 데 쓰는 물건.
wedge.englishDescription: A tool that is inserted into an object to plug a crack in it or split it.

weighing.definitionKo: 수량을 헤아리거나 부피나 무게 등을 잼.
weighing.englishDescription: An act of counting the number of things, or measuring the volume, weight, etc., of things.
The act of weighing something on a scale.

weighing.definitionKo: 속마음을 알아보거나 서로 비교하여 이리저리 헤아려 보는 일.
weighing.englishDescription: The act of trying to figure out the true intention of someone or comparing things from different angles.

will.englishDescription: An intention or will to do something.

will.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 현상이 제구실을 해 나가는 힘.
will.englishDescription: The force behind a certain object or phenomenon's enabling them to do what is expected of them .
One's resolve or will harvored in one's mind.
The written record of one's will.

will.definitionKo: 죽기 전에 말을 남김. 또는 그 말.
will.englishDescription: An act of leaving a word at one's deathbed, or such a remark.
The written record of one's will.

will.definitionKo: 상대방의 어떤 명령이나 요청에 대해 그대로 하겠다는 동의의 뜻을 나타내는 말.
will.englishDescription: To respond affirmatively to an order or request, agreeing to do as one has been told.
One's will or intention to do something.

yae.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이 아이' (this child).
The name of the vowel 'ㅒ' in the Korean alphabet.

yae.definitionKo: 한글 자모 ‘ㅑ’와 ‘ㅣ’를 모아 쓴 글자. 이름은 ‘얘’이고 중성으로 쓴다.
yae.englishDescription: The compound vowel of the Korean alphabet pronounced 'yae', which is made by adding 'ㅣ' to 'ㅑ' and used as a middle vowel letter.

yeollyeomun.definitionKo: 열녀를 기리기 위해 세운 붉은 문.
yeollyeomun.englishDescription: memorial gate for a virtuous widow: A red gate put up to praise a virtuous widow

yoreonajoreona.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하나 조리하나' (do this way or that way).
An abbreviated word for '요러하나 조러하나' (be this way or that way).
